name: icloud-mail-mcp
description: A stateless Cloudflare Workers MCP server for iCloud Mail, Calendar, and Contacts over IMAP, SMTP, CalDAV, and CardDAV.

OAUTH_KV.description: Automatically provision a KV namespace for OAuth clients, authorization state, grants, access tokens, and refresh tokens. It must not contain mail content.

MAIL_CREDENTIALS_KV.description: Automatically provision a KV namespace for encrypted per-user iCloud credentials.

MAIL_CREDENTIALS_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encryption key for per-user iCloud credentials. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`; do not reuse your iCloud password.
